notes:
Background:
- Mid-size payments platform with cross-border data regulations (NA + EU).  Sensitive PII and financial event logs; strict retention and tamper-proof audit needs.
- Primary ask: Private VPC deployment with customer-managed KMS/HSM + end-to-end encryption guarantees.

Security review summary (recent):
- 2026-03-01 call w/ security + infra leads (Fireflies: ff_2026-03-01-AB12): walked through high-level architecture. Security lead quote: "Must demonstrate that Redwood never holds unencrypted customer payloads in plaintext outside the customer's KMS boundary."
- Requested artifacts: SOC2 Type II, network architecture diagram, crypto whitepaper, pen test summary, key rotation policy. Drafts uploaded to Drive.
- Internal sec review timeline: initial design review done (2026-02-20), crypto Q&A scheduled 2026-03-15, in-VPC audit target week of 2026-03-22.

Encryption posture (detailed requirements):
- In-transit: TLS1.3 mandatory across control and data plane. mTLS between customer VPC egress and Redwood data-plane endpoints; client certs provisioned by customer CA OR Redwood-issued certs anchored to customer root.
- Mutual auth: support for pinned client cert rotation (customer-managed CA) and automatic cert renewal hooks.
- Service mesh: recommended Envoy/istio-based sidecars inside Redwood Private with mTLS enforced; customer asked for proof-of-concept of mutual auth handshake.
- At-rest: AES-256-GCM (or FIPS-approved cipher suites) for block storage, object storage, and backups. Snapshots encrypted envelope-style with customer CMK where possible.
- KMS integration: BYOK support for AWS KMS/GCP KMS/Azure Key Vault + PKCS#11 HSM binding for on-prem HSMs. Customer wants explicit KMS grant/usage logs as part of audit trail.
- Key hierarchy: envelope encryption: data keys rotated frequently (90-day default), master/key-encrypting keys rotated annually; supports automated rotation via operator + offline rotation windows.
- Secrets management: integrated HashiCorp Vault transit for dynamic credentials; support for Vault Kubernetes injector and sealed-secrets for bootstrap. No secrets stored unencrypted in Git.
- Root-of-trust: optional HSM-backed root keys (customer HSM) for highest assurance customers; Redwood supports HSM attestations / PKCS#11.
- Audit logging: all KMS operations, grant changes, key rotations forwarded to customer's SIEM (Splunk/Elastic) and stored with immutability/retention policies (customer requested 7yr retention for EU logs). Logs must be signed/chained for tamper evidence.
- Data residency: option to pin storage and log sinks to EU region for EU-subsets of data; explicit routing rules required.

POC & milestones (agreed):
- POC goal: demonstrate private VPC deployment with customer CMK + mTLS mutual auth + log forwarding to SIEM.
- Milestone 1 (2026-03-05): deploy sandbox VPC + basic connectivity (done).
- Milestone 2 (2026-03-15): KMS integration + envelope encryption test (in progress).
- Milestone 3 (2026-03-22): Audit log ingestion test to Splunk + retention policy verification (planned).
- Milestone 4 (2026-04-05): Key rotation runbook + HSM integration trial (target).

Technical notes / questions from SE (Liam):
- Need confirmation on whether Redwood control plane ever sees unencrypted model payloads when using BYOK + envelope encryption. Customer requires an architecture diagram showing cryptographic boundaries.
- SE requested step-by-step for KMS grant lifecycle and an example of automated key rotation with zero-downtime.
- Customer wants option to disable outbound internet egress and use PrivateLink/VPC peering for all control-plane traffic.

Procurement/contracting items:
- Legal flags: data residency addendum, log retention SLA, breach notification windows.
- Procurement requests: FIPS endpoint options, indemnity language around third-party HSM.

Next steps (short):
- Provide final crypto whitepaper addressing envelope encryption + control-plane access (owner: Redwood SE, due 2026-03-12).
- Schedule in-VPC audit with customer's infra team (target week 2026-03-22).
- Demo KMS rotation automation and provide runbook + sample CloudTrail/Syslog forwarding config.
- Legal to draft data residency addendum and HSM appendix.

Blockers (present):
- Legal: pending signoff on cross-border retention clauses.
- HSM: customer requires proof of HSM PKCS#11 flow which we cannot fully validate until HSM trial hardware is provisioned.
- SLA: procurement pushing for 99.99% uptime SLA on Private control plane (negotiation ongoing).

Notes about tone: entries are shorthand for internal AE/SE/CSM sync. Follow ups recorded in drive & Fireflies.
